description: Coordinator hooks — session guardrails and cost optimization. REGISTRATIONS IN THIS FILE ARE READ AT SESSION START AND CACHED: adding or removing an entry here reaches NO already-running session until it runs /reload-plugins or restarts, and a deleted entry keeps firing until then. Run /reload-plugins in this session before testing your change, and expect peer sessions on this machine to keep their booted roster regardless. Hook SCRIPT bodies are unaffected — those resolve live per tool call. Measurement: docs/wiki/external-plugin-live-resolution.md § Hook REGISTRATION staleness; tripwire HOOKS-JSON-REGISTRATION-STALENESS.

hooks._comment: Register entry #15. Fires on every OSS install regardless of whether claude-klabauter resolves in the sibling registry: _resolve_live_working_tree() returns (None, provenance) with no repos.claude_klabauter rung, and the script exits 0 having emitted nothing on that arm. CwdChanged carries no matcher enforcement; all narrowing happens in-script against old_cwd/new_cwd.

hooks._comment: Register entry #21. C1's probe (docs/research/spike-verdicts/2026-09-11-configchange-trigger-scope-and-block-path.md) verdict: BUILD -- out-of-band settings.local.json edits and disableAllHooks:true flips FIRE (source local_settings); a plugin hooks/hooks.json edit does not; decision:block is emitted-and-ignored on this event. Fires and flags via additionalContext only, scoped to source==local_settings; never sets decision:block. ConfigChange carries no matcher enforcement either, so narrowing happens in-script against the payload.
